defeats.how: Nocturne used her empathic powers to make White feel the agony of the drug addicts he preys upon, leaving him screaming.
defeats.evidence: Nocturne uses her empathic powers to make him feel the agony of those of the drug addicts he preys upon them

defeats.how: The synopsis only says Nocturne managed to convince the Puma to stop before he attacked White.
defeats.evidence: Nocturne manages to convince him to stop

defeats.how: Warned by his spider-sense of the Puma's ambush, Spider-Man evaded his blows and fought him off.
When Nocturne got in the way of the Puma's attack on Spider-Man, he slashed her across the face, leaving her down.
defeats.evidence: Nocturne gets in the way and is slashed across the face
